The GP who gave evidence at the inquest, Dr from Bodriggy Health Centre in Hayle, stated that she had never been contacted by another doctor considering the prescription of opiate or other medication to Mrs Corrigan. She was able to procure the medication in sufficient quantities first to require an emergency admission to hospital and latterly to result in her death. Similarly, the registered GP was not contacted by any dispensing pharmacist checking whether the prescription was appropriate.
